# Review agent work and recover transaction evidence

Scope to the named repositories, time window, issue and evidence the session can access. Start with the WBS, saved issue and PR discussions, recorded device logs and the shared PrivateResearch working-baselines index. Use a GitHub connector, website or CLI for the same issue or comment. Use accessible Codex, Copilot, VS Code Stable or Insiders and LM Studio exports when they add evidence. Infer the workspace from each ledger entry, not the log file's location. Record unavailable or rotated sources so the coverage is explicit.

Join each observation with the operator report, UTC timestamp, model and camera mode, attachment, exact artifact and loaded source pair, transaction and outcome. Link raw or sanitized evidence and distinguish operator report, observed transaction and independent verification. For a positive setting require live readback and record restoration separately. For capture require terminal lifecycle, the attributable file or declared destination, and returned control. Latest matching evidence carries more weight. Refer to ambiguous historical versions as leads pending exact identity.

Group recurring failures and worked examples around concrete decisions. Add a durable baseline only when the evidence supports the claim. Add or revise a skill when a repeatable failure can be detected by a fixture. Keep the shared procedure in ordinary Markdown and use repository-relative paths. Preserve a coverage record for all examined conversation sources.

In the WBS or the existing owning issue, report the exact commits, fixture, evidence path, remaining uncertainty and executable next gate. Search for a canonical issue before suggesting a new one. Use only the relevant excerpts when publishing a shared handover.
